description: Fixed, non-private 20-turn chat prompts for the PowerInfer acceptance gate. Do not replace with project story text.
turns: Say hello in one short sentence.
What is 17 plus 25?
Name three primary colors.
Give a one-sentence definition of latency.
Rewrite this clearly: the gpu is currently idle.
List two reasons to keep a server on loopback only.
What is the capital of France?
Complete the phrase: once upon a time
Give a one-line Python hello world.
Is 91 a prime number? Answer yes or no, then one reason.
Summarize TCP versus UDP in one sentence.
Name a safe default host bind for a local LLM server.
Convert 12 gibibytes to mebibytes.
What does VRAM stand for?
Give one risk of exposing an LLM API on 0.0.0.0.
Write a two-line checklist for a cold-start benchmark.
What is a token in language-model inference?
Name the activation family PowerInfer sparse inference requires.
Give a one-sentence difference between prefill and decode.
Reply with the single word ready if you can still follow instructions.
